描述_EN: according to the engraving in willemin's work (1839), the fragment appeared to form a large square of fabric in good condition, but is now torn into several badly damaged pieces: - scrolls (fragment a) ;- eagles and lions in medallions (fragment b) ;- fragments of fabric with traces of gold thread (c and d). fragment of fabric from the tomb of an abbot in the great chapel of the abbey of saint-germain-des-prés.
描述_ZN: 根据Willemin的作品（1839年）中的雕刻，这块碎片似乎形成了一个大的方形织物，状况良好，但现在被撕成了几块严重损坏的碎片：- 卷轴（碎片a）；- 鹰和狮子的徽章（碎片b）；- 有金线痕迹的织物碎片（c和d）。 圣日耳曼德普雷修道院大礼拜堂的修道院院长墓的织物碎片。
